reason: A user-interface refinement plugin that increases cache-hit percentage precision and widens the built-in statistics line in the composer dock.

summaries.zh: 在编辑器停靠栏中将内置缓存命中率显示为三位小数，并加宽统计行以减少内容截断。
summaries.en: Displays the built-in cache-hit percentage with three decimal places and widens the composer-dock statistics line to reduce truncation.

capabilities: Reformats the built-in cache-hit percentage display to three decimal places
Widens the built-in stats line to reduce truncation
Reapplies display changes after React re-renders
